title: group spacing overflow dropdown
name: Group spacing overflow dropdown — Ant
rule: Flush groups look like a Toggle. Align in one line with spaces. Same group: no dividers. Different groups: space or a divider. If more than three operations: 1 primary + n secondary, extra into a Dropdown.
pass_when: Related actions are spaced (not flush-as-toggle); same group has no divider; different groups use space or a divider; more than three operations use 1 primary + secondaries, extras in a Dropdown.
fail_when: Flush non-toggle groups; dividers inside one group; more than three operations left in one undifferentiated strip.
overview: Spaced button groups, dividers between groups, overflow past three into Dropdown.
apply_when: Arranging multiple Ant operations in toolbars or action strips.
not_when: A true Toggle group that intentionally uses flush joined segments.
agent_hint: Space related actions; divide groups; keep 1 primary and overflow extras.
description: Flush groups can look like a Toggle—align related actions in one line with spaces. Same group: no dividers. Different groups: space or a divider. With more than three operations, keep one primary plus secondaries and move extras into a Dropdown. Flush non-toggle groups, dividers inside one group, or an undifferentiated strip of many operations all fail this Ant button guidance.
do_not_claim: A house cap other than Ant's "more than three" / Tidwell "three or four". Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.button_groups`.
